Walnut Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd, a leading consultancy services company dedicated to providing our clients with comprehensive and effective solutions to their business challenges.

At Walnut Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd, we pride ourselves on our team of experienced consultants who possess a deep understanding of various industries and business sectors. Our consultants work closely with clients to identify their unique needs and challenges, and then develop customized strategies to help them achieve their goals.

Our services include CFO services, manpower solution, registered valuer services, debt & equity financing, and management consultancy services.

Our clients include businesses of all sizes, from startups to large multinational corporations, across a range of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, and manufacturing. We are committed to building long-term relationships with our clients and working collaboratively to deliver measurable results.

## Aftab Patel (FCMA-U.K, ACMA-INDIA), (Associate)

He is a Seasoned Finance professional having more than 15 years of diversified and extensive experience in successfully formulating financial strategies to achieve business growth objectives, driving profitable operations by leveraging skills in various industries such as automobile (Tata Motors), banking (ICICI Bank Ltd) and pharma (Cipla Ltd).

He has handled critical roles like CFO (Tata Motors Indonesia, more than 5 years), Purchase Controller – Passenger Vehicles & Senior Manager Business Planning during his tenure with Tata Motors.

Close

## Priyesh Somaiya (Associate)

He is Chartered Accountant with more than 20 years of rich & diversified experience in the field of Finance, working with large corporates in different Manufacturing sectors like Petro-Chemical Fertilizer, Pharma, Building Material and Engineering Companies.

Close

## Amisha Shah (C.A. and CIMA (U.K)-Diploma), Consultant (Mentor Advisor Pvt. Ltd.)

She is Chartered Accountant with 10 years of rich & diversified experience in the field of Finance working with MNCs at different Industries level such as Manufacturing – FMCG, Audit Consultancy, IT Services, Banking – Financial Services

Her domain expertise include Budgeting/ Forecasting /Variance analysis, Assessing product profitability ,Internal control by using Risk Management Framework to provide Business solution for weak areas, Financial closing controlling & Group Reporting, SOX Compliance, Audits.

She was associated with Novartis, Kelloggs India Pvt Ltd, Castrol India, Capgemini Technologies India Pvt Ltd and Sharekhan.

Close

## Bhavin Gor (Strategic Advisor)

He is a partner in Gor & Savla practicing since 2002. He has rich experience of more than 15 years handling Audit, Taxation and Management Audit.

#### Change Management

Registered Valuer Services - Walnut | Consultancy Services

# Registered Valuer Services

We have a team of registered valuers associated with us providing a wide range of valuation services in India. Our mission is to provide accurate and reliable valuations that help our clients make informed decisions. A registered valuer is a professional who is registered with the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) and is authorized to carry out valuations of various assets as per the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Our team of registered valuers has years of experience and expertise in valuing a wide range of assets across various industries.

## What We Offer

---

We offer a comprehensive range of valuation services to our clients, including:

#### Business Valuation

We provide valuation services for businesses, including start-ups, small and medium-sized enterprises, and large corporations. Our valuation reports help our clients in making strategic decisions related to mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, IPOs, etc.

#### Property Valuation

We provide accurate valuations of various types of properties, including land, buildings, residential properties, commercial properties, industrial properties, etc.

#### Plant and Machinery Valuation

We provide valuation services for various types of plant and machinery, including manufacturing equipment, heavy machinery, office equipment, and other assets.

#### Financial Instruments Valuation

We provide valuation services for various types of financial instruments, including equity shares, preference shares, debentures, bonds, and other financial assets.

#### Intangible Asset Valuation

We provide valuation services for various types of intangible assets, including trademarks, copyrights, patents, goodwill, and other intellectual property rights.

## Why Choose Us?

---

- Expertise:Our associated registered valuers have years of experience and expertise in valuing a wide range of assets across various industries.
- Accuracy: We use the latest valuation techniques and methodologies to provide accurate and reliable valuations to our clients.
- Compliance: We strictly adhere to the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, and ensure that our valuations are compliant with all applicable regulations.
- Confidentiality:We maintain the highest level of confidentiality and ensure that our clients' information is kept secure.
- Timeliness:We understand the importance of timely delivery and ensure that our valuations are delivered within the agreed timeframe.

## Connect With Us

---

If you're looking for reliable and accurate valuation services, we would love to hear from you. Contact us today to schedule a consultation and learn more about how we can help you make informed decisions.
